tagline: The pine-fringed bays of the Gulf of Göcek and a chain of islands: short passages, swims in turquoise coves and anchorages right by the shore.

harbor.note: Home port — Göcek, Turkey. The sailing season runs from May to October.

routes.name: Autumn Breeze
routes.mapImageAlt: Chart of the “Autumn Breeze” route: Göcek — Sarsala — Dalyan — Ölüdeniz — Gemiler — Boynuz Bükü

itinerary.title: A week of “Autumn Breeze”, day by day

summary.title: A loop around the bays of the Turquoise Coast

itinerary.intro: The order of the stops depends on the wind and the mood of the crew.

days.label: Day 1
days.title: Boarding in Göcek
days.text: We meet at the marina in the afternoon: settling into cabins, getting to know the boat and a safety briefing. In the evening, a first dinner with the whole crew and plans for the week.

days.label: Day 2
days.title: Sarsala Bay
days.text: A short passage to the south of the gulf: anchoring in Sarsala, a swim in turquoise water and lunch on board. In the evening, a quiet shore and stars.

days.label: Day 3
days.title: Dalyan
days.text: The longest passage of the week — west, to Dalyan. Open sea and wind along the way; in the evening, a walk ashore and dinner at a restaurant.

days.label: Days 4–5
days.title: Ölüdeniz and Gemiler
days.text: We return by way of the eastern bays: the famous Ölüdeniz lagoon and Gemiler Island with its Byzantine ruins. Swims, walks and sunsets you will be talking about afterwards.

days.label: Day 6
days.title: Boynuz Bükü
days.text: A quiet pine-fringed bay at the entrance to the Gulf of Göcek — the last stop on the route. A long swim, coffee on deck and a farewell dinner.

days.label: Day 7
days.title: Disembarkation
days.text: Breakfast on board, an unhurried passage to Göcek marina, packing and disembarkation before noon. We help with transfers and share the week’s photos.

itinerary.note: The schedule is flexible: the sea and the forecast may change the order of the days, but not the holiday itself.
